web.title: Medical exemption from Medicare levy | Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# Medical exemption from Medicare levy ## On this page - [Family agreement for Medicare levy exemption](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-exemption/medical-exemption-from-medicare-levy#ato-FamilyagreementforMedicarelevyexemption) ## Conditions for medical exemption from Medicare levy | Condition | Exemption that applies | |-|-| | You had dependent children who were not in an exemption category but who were also dependants of your spouse, and your spouse either:
- had to pay the Medicare levy
- met at least one of the Category 1 [medical conditions](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-exemption/medical-exemption-from-medicare-levy#Medicalconditions) and you have completed a [family agreement](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-exemption/medical-exemption-from-medicare-levy#FamilyagreementforMedicarelevyexemption) stating that your spouse will pay half of the levy for your joint dependants. | Full | | You had a spouse who met at least one of the Category 1 [medical conditions](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-exemption/medical-exemption-from-medicare-levy#Medicalconditions) and you had a dependent child who was:
- not in an exemption category, and
- dependent on both of you. | Either you or your spouse can claim a **full** exemption and the other can claim a **half** exemption by completing a [family agreement](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/medicare-and-private-health-insurance/medicare-levy/medicare-levy-exemption/medical-exemption-from-medicare-levy#FamilyagreementforMedicarelevyexemption). |

web.title: M1 Medicare levy reduction or exemption 2026
web.description:
# M1 Medicare levy reduction or exemption 2026 ## Part B – Medicare levy exemption ### Category 1: Medical | Additional condition met | Exemption that applies | |-|-| | You had dependent children who aren't in an exemption category but who are also dependants of your spouse, and your spouse either:
- has to pay the Medicare levy
- meets at least one of the **Category 1:** **Medical** conditions and you have a [family agreement](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2026-instructions/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2-individual-tax-return-2026/m1-medicare-levy-reduction-or-exemption-2026#Familyagreements) stating that your spouse will pay the half levy for your joint dependants. | Full | | You had at least one dependant (for example, a spouse) who both:
- isn't in an exemption category
- doesn't have to pay the Medicare levy (for example, because their taxable income is below the lower Medicare levy threshold), see [Table 1](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2026-instructions/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2-individual-tax-return-2026/m1-medicare-levy-reduction-or-exemption-2026#Table1). | Half | | You have a spouse who meets at least one of the **Category 1: Medical** conditions and you have a dependent child who:
- isn't in an exemption category, and
- is dependent on both of you.
In this case, either you or your spouse can claim a full exemption and the other can claim a half exemption by completing a [family agreement](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/individual-tax-return-2026-instructions/medicare-levy-questions-m1-m2-individual-tax-return-2026/m1-medicare-levy-reduction-or-exemption-2026#Familyagreements). | Full or Half |
